ideas.title: The Impact of the Federal Reserve Investigation on the Economy
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential impact of the Federal Reserve investigation on the economy and the financial system.
ideas.angle: The investigation's potential impact on interest rates and monetary policy.
questions: What are the potential implications of the investigation for the economy?
How could the investigation impact monetary policy?
ideas.insight: The investigation into the Federal Reserve has significant implications for the economy and the financial system. It is essential to investigate further to determine the potential impact on interest rates and monetary policy.

ideas.title: The Extent of Minnesota Welfare Fraud

questions: What is the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
How has the freeze on food stamp funding impacted the state?
